svg.title: 02 · Food as hero moments: open, last call, on the way, here
svg.text: 02 · Food as hero moments: open, last call, on the way, here
Main hall at 1080p in Demo night. The food box stays the steady place; the hero gets each change of the order for a short while, and nothing shows in two places at once.

g.text: Semi-finals start at 19:40 on the main stage · Quiz at 21:15 in the lounge
Order on your phone before it closes

svg.text: Takes the hero with the QR; the run of show fills the rail until it steps down after 90 s.

g.text: Semi-finals start at 19:40 on the main stage · Quiz at 21:15 in the lounge
Demo Pizzeria · scan now to join
At 18:30 the order goes to the pizzeria

svg.text: Five minutes before the close, with its own sound; holds the hero for 60 s.

g.text: Semi-finals start at 19:40 on the main stage · Quiz at 21:15 in the lounge

svg.text: The ETA as a big countdown; meanwhile the hub QR takes its turn in the rail.

g.text: Quiz at 21:15 in the lounge · Finals at 22:15 on the main stage
Order 3 · Collect at the front desk

svg.text: Important: the hero, then the food box, then the ticker. Confetti at lively and party only.
One order, 18:15 to 19:00: what shows where
Nothing about the order while the hero or the food box shows it
One moment, one place at a time: while the hero holds a food moment, the food box gives its space to the run of show or the rail's next item, and the ticker leaves it out.
When the hero steps down, the food box takes the moment over; the ticker carries it only after the box. The QR shows once: in the hero while it holds, else as the hub QR's turn in the rail.
Hero time: 90 s each (the event's floor), last call 60 s. Sounds: open and here as today; last call gets its own.
